### Enums

- `RatePlanCodeType`: DOES_NOT_APPLY, RATE_PLAN_CODE, RATE_PLAN_GROUPING_CODE
- `RatePlanStatusType`: INITIAL, ACTIVE, DEACTIVATED
- `RatePlanNotifScopeType`: RATE_PLAN_ONLY, RATE_ONLY, RATE_PLAN_AND_RATE, PRODUCT_RATE_ONLY, RATE_PLAN_AND_PRODUCT_RATE
- `RateplanInvCodeApplication`: DOES_NOT_APPLY, INV_CODE, INV_GROUPING_CODE
- `SupplementType`: ADDITIONAL_GUEST, BOARD, EXTRA
- `RateplanInvStatusType`: INITIAL, ACTIVE, DEACTIVATED
- `SellableProductGuestRoomOrMeetingRoomsOrInventoryBlockCase`: GUEST_ROOM, MEETING_ROOMS, INVENTORY_BLOCK
- `RateplanOffsetCalculationMode`: BEFORE_BLOCK_START_DATE, AFTER_BLOCK_CREATION
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleAcceptableGuaranteeRetributionType`: RES_AUTO_CANCELLED, RES_NOT_GUARANTEED
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleAcceptableGuaranteeGuaranteeType`: GUARANTEE_REQUIRED, NONE, CC_DC_VOUCHER, PROFILE, DEPOSIT, PRE_PAY, DEPOSIT_REQUIRED
- `RateplanGuaranteePaymentRetributionType`: RES_AUTO_CANCELLED, RES_NOT_GUARANTEED
- `RateplanGuaranteePaymentType`: REQUIRED_PAYMENT, GUARANTEE_POLICY, ACCEPTED_PAYMENT_FORMS
- `RateplanGuaranteePaymentGuaranteeType`: GUARANTEE_REQUIRED, NONE, CC_DC_VOUCHER, PROFILE, DEPOSIT, PRE_PAY
- `RateplanGuaranteePolicyType`: NO_GUARANTEES_ACCEPTED, GUARANTEES_ACCEPTED, GUARANTEES_REQUIRED, DEPOSIT_REQUIRED, GUARANTEES_NOT_REQUIRED, DEPOSIT_NOT_REQUIRED, PREPAY_REQUIRED, PREPAY_NOT_REQUIRED, NO_DEPOSITS_ACCEPTED
- `RateplanRestriction`: MASTER, ARRIVAL, DEPARTURE, NON_GUARANTEE, TRAVEL_AGENT
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleAdditionalRuleAdditionalRule`: IS_CANCELABLE, IS_MODIFIABLE, IS_REFUNDABLE, NOT_CANCELABLE, NOT_MODIFIABLE, NOT_REFUNDABLE, IS_COMMISSIONABLE, NOT_COMMISSIONABLE, CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED, ID_REQUIRED
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleCheckoutChargeType`: EARLY, LATE
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleAcceptableGuaranteeGuaranteeAcceptedShareSynchInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RatePlanBookingRulesBookingRuleAcceptableGuaranteeGuaranteeAcceptedShareMarketInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RateplanPaymentTransactionTypeCode`: CHARGE, RESERVE, REFUND
- `RateplanGuaranteeAcceptedPaymentCardChoiceCase`: PAYMENT_CARD, BANK_ACCT, DIRECT_BILL, VOUCHER, LOYALTY_REDEMPTION, MISC_CHARGE_ORDER, TICKET, CASH
- `RateplanOffsetDropTime`: BEFORE_ARRIVAL, AFTER_BOOKING, AFTER_CONFIRMATION, AFTER_ARRIVAL, AFTER_DEPARTURE
- `RateplanAcceptedPaymentPaymentCardChoiceCase`: PAYMENT_CARD, BANK_ACCT, DIRECT_BILL, VOUCHER, LOYALTY_REDEMPTION, MISC_CHARGE_ORDER, TICKET, CASH
- `RestrictionType`: ARRIVAL, DEPARTURE, BOOKING, STAY
- `RateplanCheckInhibitorType`: CHECK_DIGIT, INTERLINE_AGREEMENT, BOTH
- `RateplanReroutingType`: VOLUNTARY, INVOLUNTARY
- `RateplanPaymentCardTelephoneShareSynchInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RateplanPaymentCardTelephoneShareMarketInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RateplanEmailTextFormat`: TEXT_HTML, TEXT_PLAIN
- `RateplanPaymentCardCustLoyaltyShareSynchInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RateplanPaymentCardCustLoyaltyShareMarketInd`: YES, NO, INHERIT
- `RateplanSingleVendorInd`: SINGLE_VNDR, ALLIANCE
- `RateplanFormat`: PAPER, ELECTRONIC
- `RateplanAuthenticationVerificationValueSecureOrPlainTextCase`: SECURE, PLAIN_TEXT
- `RateplanTransactionPasswordSecureOrPlainTextCase`: SECURE, PLAIN_TEXT
